== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Joined [[Gambit Esports]] in the last week of regular season of the [[LCL/2018 Season/Spring Season|LCL 2018 Spring Split]], before being the starter during the [[LCL/2018 Season/Spring Playoffs|domestic playoffs]] and at the [[2018 Mid-Season Invitational/Play-In|2018 MSI Play-in Stage]].
** The situation replicated itself in [[LCL/2021 Season/Spring Season|LCL 2021 Spring]] and at the [[2021 Mid-Season Invitational]], with [[Unicorns of Love.CIS|Unicorns Of Love]].
* Was finishing his Bachelor's thesis while starting for [[Unicorns of Love.CIS|Unicorns Of Love]] at the [[2021 Mid-Season Invitational]].<ref>[https://www.invenglobal.com/articles/13967/uol-lodik-i-had-no-intentions-of-returning-to-competitive-play-around-this-time UOL Lodik: "I had no intentions of returning to competitive play around this time."] ''twitter.com''</ref>
